name: cd-income-tax
description: Prepare an individual income-tax research workpaper for DR Congo income earned in 2026 under the IRPP reform. Use this Guide to screen habitual residence and source, classify income, identify salary-base deductions and global deductions, apply the annual progressive scale, and distinguish an individual return from employer withholding reports. It includes the business-income minimum, conditional family relief, withholding reconciliation and two recomputing cases. The output is a supported draft calculation and filing checklist. The carried-law chain, certain statutory interactions, special workers, full investment and capital-gain calculations, and authenticated filing remain unresolved. Do not treat the research-year label or a prepared workpaper as confirmation of final tax liability or a completed filing.
